reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a OneCoin-linked payment and investment card with claims that users and recommenders earn money, while encouraging viewers to buy the card and bring in more customers for commissions. It presents the company as having both a cryptocurrency and a banking system and frames the investment card as a profitable product, without supplying substantiation for those financial claims.

citations.quote: When you recommend it, you earn money! When you use it, you earn money!
the company OneCoin has not only a cryptocurrency, but also a banking system.
The more customers we are bringing, the more commissions we are going to receive
many people come to me to buy card

opening.argument: The language describes possible benefits of using or recommending a card, but it does not specify a guaranteed amount, timetable, required deposit, or promised investment return. The description says users earn money when they recommend or use it, while the spoken account refers generally to commissions and business benefits. That is promotional reward language, not proof that viewers were promised a particular financial outcome. The available visual evidence likewise presents a card alongside a coin, without showing a contract, earnings statement, or guarantee.

citations.quote: When you recommend it, you earn money! When you use it, you earn money!
The more customers we are bringing, the more commissions we are going to receive

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited earning language is certainly promotional, but promotion alone does not establish deception. “Many people come to me to buy card” describes customer interest, while the commission statement describes a referral incentive. Neither quote establishes that money had to be deposited, that returns were guaranteed, or that the product was fictitious. The claim about a cryptocurrency and banking system is also a description of the offering, not proof of fraudulent intent.

citations.quote: many people come to me to buy card
The more customers we are bringing, the more commissions we are going to receive
the company OneCoin has not only a cryptocurrency, but also a banking system.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The problem is not merely the absence of a specified amount. The description states the earnings proposition categorically: “When you recommend it, you earn money” and “When you use it, you earn money.” The spoken material then encourages bringing more customers for commissions and calls the card an investment-related product. That combination uses financial benefit claims to encourage participation, even without stating a precise return.

citations.quote: When you recommend it, you earn money! When you use it, you earn money!
many people have a lot of problems making profit with the investment card.
The more customers we are bringing, the more commissions we are going to receive

opening.argument: The material can be understood as a product discussion centered on what the card is and how it relates to the issuer’s services. The speaker introduces the topic as returning to “these cards,” discusses the claimed bank license and cryptocurrency, and describes how the card is used in a broader business context. The frames consistently show a physical payment card beside a coin, supporting a product-focused demonstration rather than documenting a recruitment event or an investment transaction. No supplied frame shows a signup, transfer of funds, or payout.

citations.quote: let's go back to these cards.
the company OneCoin received a license from a bank in Dubai.
the company OneCoin has not only a cryptocurrency, but also a banking system.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The product framing does not neutralize the message’s financial purpose. The speaker says the card will be successful, discusses profit, and connects additional customers with commissions. A video can show a product while soliciting participation in it. The card image establishes what is being promoted, but it does not turn the accompanying earnings claims into neutral instruction or analysis.

citations.quote: With this kind of card will be very successful.
many people have a lot of problems making profit with the investment card.
The more customers we are bringing, the more commissions we are going to receive

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling this a product discussion overlooks its operative message. The description explicitly tells viewers what they earn by recommending and using the card, and the speaker says more customers generate more commissions. The bank and cryptocurrency discussion supplies credibility for the offer rather than detached technical education. Showing the physical card does not remove the solicitation conveyed by the surrounding earnings claims.

citations.quote: When you recommend it, you earn money! When you use it, you earn money!
The more customers we are bringing, the more commissions we are going to receive
many people come to me to buy card

opening.argument: The observable subject is an ordinary payment-card product and related business service. The title identifies a Mastercard, the frames show a physical card, and the narration discusses customers, card use, and commissions. Crucially, the supplied material does not show a required deposit, a request for credentials, a guaranteed return schedule, or an explicit instruction to recruit a downline. A referral commission can occur in ordinary commerce, so the presence of customer referrals and product benefits is insufficient by itself to establish a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: Card OneCoin Mastercard
many people come to me to buy card
everything which is going to go thr with this card will be given to benefit from these businesses.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The evidence does show a product and a referral incentive, but it does not show an ordinary retail transaction either. The speaker links customer growth to commissions and calls the card an investment card associated with profit. The absence of a visible deposit or credential request cannot prove the absence of a deceptive financial proposition; promotional claims can occur before those steps.

citations.quote: many people have a lot of problems making profit with the investment card.
The more customers we are bringing, the more commissions we are going to receive
When you recommend it, you earn money!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is more than a neutral referral discount. The description promises money for both recommending and using the card, while the narration encourages bringing more customers for commissions and presents the card as connected to investment profit. Those statements supply the financial inducement. The fact that the sampled frames show only a card does not contradict the spoken solicitation.

The more customers we are bringing, the more commissions we are going to receive
